title: Trader Diary: 83k BTC & My 10x Leverage Dreams
content:
Check the chart at 2 AM: BTC dips to $83,590, my heart does a double‑take.
I whisper “just one more long” while my margin‑call alarm screams.
Coffee’s gone cold, but my position is hotter than a summer meme.
lesson: Never risk more than you can afford to lose – especially when the price is flirting with your liquidation.
question: Who’s still holding the 10x after the dip? Drop your battle scars 👇
